blocks.x: Dataq Swarm's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.
Structurally Dataq Swarm is planes, not layers — workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
In Dataq Swarm architecture, the working system, decomposed:

items: health, throughput, cost and policy telemetry
roles, bidding, priority lanes, SLA routing

blocks.x: Instrumented from week one, on your channels — Dataq Swarm edition:

Runtime dependencies: Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Dataq Swarm follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring Dataq Swarm architecture to a 45-minute briefing with the practice lead — your metric, our method, and an honest read on feasibility.
